# Tafsir Fidelity Batch — programmatic run trigger
#
# Pushing ANY change to this file on the 'main' branch starts the
# "Tafsir Fidelity Batch" workflow (.github/workflows/tafsir-fidelity-batch.yml).
# To trigger a run: update the timestamp on the 'triggered' line below to the
# current UTC time, then commit + push. (Git needs the content to change to make
# a commit, so the timestamp must differ each time.)
#
# Safety: the batch is resumable and idempotent. It skips every (sura, aya) row
# already scored and upserts to Supabase with resolution=merge-duplicates, so
# re-runs never create duplicate rows. Secrets live only in GitHub Actions
# secrets; none are ever read from this file.
triggered 2026-09-11T22:41:53Z
